audits.public_index_policy: Fresh public-web searches combining each permit with 2024 and Pollution Inventory returned no explicit target-year annual Air substance rows. Absence from the public index is not treated as zero; it only preserves fail-closed state.
audits.tilbury_lifecycle: Part95 permit-only scope is refined: the official status log records a 2021 part transfer from KP3936ZB to WP3007LM for the Line 2/Thameside scope. This does not retract a numeric candidate because Part95 created none; it prevents future facility/permit conflation.
audits.permit_limit_policy: IED permit ELVs, concentrations, monitoring frequencies and BAT limits are never converted to annual mass candidates.
audits.widmerpool_reference_policy: Official variation notice confirms EPR/QP3936AX. Any secondary typo such as GP3936AX is not propagated.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official 2024 PI ZIP remains downloadable in principle but binary facility rows remain unconsumed in this runtime; direct row count remains zero.
audits.zero_policy: Missing, unretrieved or unindexed annual mass values remain no-data, never zero.
